title: Treatment and management / CALF DIARRHEA / RESPIRATORY PROBLEM
text:
Treatment and management:
Prevention is better than cure
a) Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the calf barn.
b) Disinfect the navel regularly.
c) Sufficient colostrum intake.

2. CALF DIARRHEA
Causes:
a) Bacterial
b) Viral (clostridium)
c) Environmental (dirty calf pen, cold weather)
d) Nutrition (bad milk, sudden change in diet)
e) Stress (noise, overcrowding)
f) Insufficient colostrum intake
Clinical signs:
- Loose bowel
- Dirty or stained caudal area
- Dehydrated
- Fever
- Lethargic

3. RESPIRATORY PROBLEM
Causes:
a) Bacterial
b) Viral (clostridium)
c) Environmental (dirty calf pen, cold weather)
d) Stress (overcrowding)
e) Insufficient colostrum intake
Clinical signs:
- Fever
- Labored breathing
- Coughing (especially when startled or agitated)
